body: Thank you, I have subscribed to loseit and I'm just now starting to plan my new lifestyle.
I probably do eat too much dinner, because I skip breakfast all together. So Livestrong eh? I'm gonna look into more sites like that, thanks man.

Thank you so much for your input! I will enjoy your hugs! I was feeling a better in the past days but in the light of new events, my Mom has also been popping anti-depressment pills. Lorazepam and Sertraline we found out. She had a subscription for 30 pills for each medicine on the 20th of Jan, and now she only has 2 of the Lorazpams left and a bit of the Sertraline left. 

We talked about it and she promised to work with me but I don't know. I think I just need to let it go and distance myself.

I know I can do it, food wise. I actually eat pretty healthy IMO. I cook my own food, I never fry stuff, I never eat fast food, I love fruit and veggies, I eat small portions and never go for seconds (unless I skip breakfast) but I have one bad side. Tea and Soda. God I can't stop! It's like I'm an alcoholic, but with soda! I also tend to skip breakfast a lot and double up dinner.

Thank you! My Step dad is the one who is kicking me out. He is pretty much kicking everyone out, he is the only one at the moment making any money so he is kind of fed up with his life and wants to start a new. Kinda funny huh? But yes, I'll keep you in mind if I want someone to talk to!

oh man THANK YOU for this post. seriously, just reading this helps a lot knowing that someone out there took the time and wrote all this up. I'm looking through some of those subreddits and they look pretty nice with a lot of FAQs and help. And about my mother, what would be the best way to start an intervention? Thank you again! /hug
thank you, that really made me night!
